text_blocks.snippet: The Johnson & Johnson (J&J) COVID-19 vaccine, also known as Janssen COVID-19 vaccine, is a single-dose vaccine that was 66% effective in clinical trials against moderate to severe COVID-19 infections. It was approved for people 18 and older. While it was once available in the U.S., it is no longer being administered. According to Yale Medicine, the vaccine expired as of May 6, 2023.
